Coram : S. ABDUL NAZEER, J.K. MAHESHWARI
v. A.S. SARAVANA KARTHIK SHA (Civil Appeal No(s). 4894 of 2022) JULY 18, 2022 [S. ABDUL NAZEER AND J. K. MAHESHWARI] Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 – s.24 – Transfer – Power u/s.24, exercise of – Matrimonial matters – Petition filed by appellant-wife seeking of power u/s.24 is that the ends of justice should demand the transfer of the suit, appeal or other proceeding – Given the prevailing socio- economic paradigm in the Indian society, generally, it is the wife’s convenience which must be looked at while considering transfer –
Decision Date : 18-07-2022 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 4894/2022 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
